// Temporary macOS diagnostic: does a write made right after chokidar's `ready` reach the watcher?
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import chokidar from 'chokidar';

const mode = process.argv[2] ?? 'immediate';
const workDir = mkdtempSync(path.join(process.cwd(), '.lrdiag-'));
const pageA = path.join(workDir, 'PageA.svelte');
const probe = path.join(workDir, 'Probe.svelte');
writeFileSync(pageA, '<h1>A v1</h1>\n');
writeFileSync(probe, '<p>probe</p>\n');

const w = chokidar.watch(['src', workDir], { ignoreInitial: true, ignored: [/(^|[/\\])node_modules([/\\]|$)/], cwd: process.cwd() });
const changed = (file: string, ms: number) =>
  new Promise<number | null>((resolve) => {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const h = (p: string) => {
      if (path.resolve(p) === file) {
        w.off('change', h);
        resolve(performance.now() - t0);
      }
    };
    w.on('change', h);
    setTimeout(() => {
      w.off('change', h);
      resolve(null);
    }, ms);
  });
await new Promise<void>((r) => w.once('ready', () => r()));
let probeTries = 0;
if (mode === 'probe') {
  for (;;) {
    probeTries++;
    const seen = changed(probe, 500);
    writeFileSync(probe, `<p>probe ${probeTries}</p>\n`);
    if ((await seen) !== null) break;
  }
}
const seen = changed(pageA, 3000);
writeFileSync(pageA, '<h1>A v2</h1>\n');
const latency = await seen;
console.log(`RESULT mode=${mode} ${latency === null ? 'LOST' : 'SEEN'} latency=${latency?.toFixed(1) ?? '-'} probeTries=${probeTries}`);
await w.close();
rmSync(workDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
